The groups below come from shared source-ID prefixes in the chart data. They organize the font pages; they do not assert that the charts are historical typeface families. A YAML file selects one small border or motif from the digitized pattern corpus for each group. The motif is drawn as a decorative frame around the TXT chart sheet; the glyph matrices and TTF outlines are unchanged.

The 2007–45 source group has no border or edging chart in the current pattern index. Its frame uses a rosette chart from that same group at the corners, with plain rules between them. That frame is a new display treatment, not a border documented in the source.

## Similarity across source groups

The within-group scores summarize binary silhouette overlap between pages with at least three shared labels. They are exploratory descriptive statistics, not validated typeface-family classifications. The downloadable [metrics data](fonts/similarity-metrics.json) contains the method, limitations, per-group summaries, and page-pair scores.
